sources.title: Coca-Cola's World Cup AI Avatar Showcases Brand's Cutting-edge AI ...
sources.snippet: While many World Cup-themed AI marketing activations have focused primarily on AI-generated content, Coca-Cola China's campaign brings together both an AIGC-powered creative film and a virtual football ambassador. The initiative demonstrates how AI can support not only content creation but also consumer engagement at scale.
